title: Spark landing entrance visuals and step frames
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact, brand-forward landing experience for the Quickstart entry page ('Spark' variant) focused on a single above-the-fold entrance visual, three progressive step frames, and a lightweight animated transition between steps. Designs must be handoff-ready for engineering with responsive breakpoints, exportable assets, and annotated motion specs.
problem_statement: The current quickstart landing feels visually heavy and duplicates content across hero and step regions. We need a leaner entrance that communicates 'time-to-first-call' (developer centric) and shows the three next steps in a compact, scannable manner while preserving brand tone and accessibility.
goals: Reduce perceived time-to-first-call by surfacing one primary CTA and inline step cards
Provide a reusable 'entrance' component that can be used on product pages and docs
Ship pixel-specs and asset exports for engineering and implement motion within Console v2 release window
deliverables: Figma master file (Spark Landing v1) with components and tokens
Desktop / tablet / mobile layouts annotated for breakpoints
SVG and PNG asset exports (illustrations + step icons) with export presets
Interaction and motion spec (Lottie and CSS fallback notes)
Handoff README describing variant rules and copy guidance
in_scope: Three step frames (Start, Integrate, Monitor) with microcopy
Accessible color contrasts and focus states
out_of_scope: Full onboarding flow beyond the landing page (deep walkthrough pages)
Back-end analytics instrumentation (handled by product analytics)
Localized translations—copy will be English-only for this iteration
acceptance_criteria: Design file contains a single reusable Entrance component with three switchable content states
Engineering can export assets directly from provided layers (SVGs for icons, PNGs for raster)
Motion spec includes a Lottie JSON and a documented CSS fallback that performs within 120ms on 3G simulated mobile
Contrast checks pass WCAG AA for body text and CTA across breakpoints
PM sign-off recorded in comments and Figma prototype linked in ticket
screenshot_matrix: Desktop 1440px: full-bleed entrance with step-frame rail to the right
Tablet 900px: stacked entrance then step-frame carousel (2-up)
Mobile 375px: entrance on top, step frames as horizontally scrollable cards
microcopy: Primary headline: 'Ship an LLM feature in minutes'
Subhead: 'Starter templates, a single API call, and traffic-aware defaults.'
Step 1 blurb: 'Create a project, pick a model, and get an API key.'
Step 2 blurb: 'Install our SDK and add a /generate route.'
Step 3 blurb: 'See latency, cost, and quality metrics in the Console.'
accessibility_notes: All CTAs must be reachable via keyboard and have a visible focus ring
Entrance illustration must have descriptive alt text and reduced-motion Lottie variant
Color tokens use updated brand palette with AA contrast for 14px body text
dependencies: ENG-20412 (console ingestion point for new entrance component)
